attributes.label: Display Technology
attributes.description: Panel type (QLED, OLED, Mini-LED, etc.) that determines color volume, contrast, and brightness capability.

attributes.label: Resolution
attributes.description: Native pixel count of the screen — 4K UHD, 8K, or Full HD — defining sharpness and detail.

attributes.label: Screen Size
attributes.description: Diagonal screen measurement in inches, a primary filter for room fit and viewing distance.

attributes.label: Refresh Rate & Motion Handling
attributes.description: Native and effective refresh rate (Hz) plus motion-smoothing technology, critical for sports and gaming.

attributes.label: HDR Support
attributes.description: HDR formats supported (Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HDR10, HLG) affecting highlight detail and color depth.

attributes.label: Smart TV Platform & App Ecosystem
attributes.description: Operating system and app store (Google TV, Tizen, webOS, Android TV) determining content access and UI experience.

attributes.label: Gaming Features
attributes.description: Low input lag, VRR, ALLM, HDMI 2.1 bandwidth, and dedicated game modes for console and PC gaming.

attributes.label: Audio Quality & Sound System
attributes.description: Built-in speaker wattage, audio formats (Dolby Atmos, DTS), and sound enhancement technologies.

attributes.label: Connectivity & Ports
attributes.description: Number and type of HDMI, USB, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and other ports for devices and peripherals.

attributes.label: Processor & Memory (RAM/Storage)
attributes.description: SoC performance, RAM, and internal storage affecting UI responsiveness, app loading, and multitasking.

attributes.label: Picture Calibration & Color Accuracy
attributes.description: Color gamut coverage (DCI-P3, sRGB), factory calibration, and local dimming zones for accurate, vivid images.

attributes.label: Design, Bezels & Installation
attributes.description: Bezel width, stand style, VESA mount compatibility, and overall form factor for room aesthetics and wall mounting.

attributes.label: Price / Value
attributes.description: Price, budget fit and overall value

clusters.label: Cinephile & Streaming Enthusiast
clusters.description: Buyers who prioritize the best possible picture and sound quality for movies, TV shows, and streaming services at home.

clusters.label: Console & PC Gamer
clusters.description: Buyers who need high refresh rates, low input lag, HDMI 2.1, and VRR support for a competitive or immersive gaming experience.

clusters.label: Smart Home & Streaming-First User
clusters.description: Buyers who care most about the smart platform ecosystem, voice assistants, app availability, and seamless integration with other smart devices.

clusters.label: Large Room / Big-Screen Upgrader
clusters.description: Buyers choosing a TV primarily based on screen size and resolution to fill a living room or home theater space.

clusters.label: Value-Conscious Everyday Buyer
clusters.description: Buyers balancing overall performance across picture, smart features, and build quality against cost, often comparing mid-range models.
